full_text_zh:
[P1] 款冬姑娘
[日] 田岛征三 著·绘
彭懿 译

这个故事发生在东京都西多摩郡日出村。
那里的人，管款冬的花茎叫“款冬包包”。“包包”，就是包子的意思。因为款冬的花茎圆圆的、
胖乎乎的，就像包子一样。
田岛征三

光明日报出版社

[P2] 一个闷热无比的夏夜，款冬姑娘睡不着，来到了屋外的走廊上。
她看着对面的山，发现了一件奇怪的事。
山上的一个地方，有什么东西在闪闪发光。
一定是数不清的星星落在了那里。

[P3] 款冬姑娘出发了，
她要去山上捡星星。
田间小路映着星光，一片银白。对面人家的牛还没睡觉。款冬
姑娘从牛棚前面走过。

[P4] 沿着堂屋的后门走过去，就是一条上山的小路。
款冬姑娘沿着栎树和橡树之间的小道，朝山上爬去。
走了没一会儿，小道变得陡峭起来。
款冬姑娘心想，
那么多星星一定是落在了山顶上。

[P5] 款冬姑娘好失望。
原来，像星星一样闪闪发光的、是数不清的款冬叶子，
还有叶子上的夜露。
款冬姑娘出神地看着款冬的叶子在风中摇动……
“你看上去怎么那么伤心呢？”
离她最近的一棵款冬，呼啦啦地摇动巨大的叶子。
“怎么能不伤心呢？人家明明是来捡星星的嘛。”
“哈哈哈。”
款冬的叶子一阵摇晃。
“我们可是捡到好多啊。你看——”
款冬们说。
可不，叶子上的夜露里，有星光在闪烁。
“像这样顶在头上，凉凉的，好舒服哦。”

[P6] 款冬姑娘也想把夜露顶在头上，可是——骨碌碌，就顺着
脖梗子滚了下去，凉丝丝的。
“你看，要这样。”
一棵个子高挑的款冬，轻轻晃动了一下身体。
于是，叶子上面的夜露，就变成了好多颗小水珠，滚了起来。
接着，汇集到了叶子中央，变成了一颗大水珠。
然后，它们像坐滑梯似的，沿着花茎的凹槽滑了下去，
最后渗进脚边的泥土里。
“款冬也想滑。”款冬姑娘说。
“咦，你也叫款冬吗？”

[P7] “是呀，大家都管我叫款冬包包。你看，我的脸圆圆的、
鼓鼓的。像不像包子呀？
“我们的孩子也叫款冬包包哟。”
不知不觉中，款冬姑娘坐在一片巨大的款冬叶子上，
摇晃起来。
她从款冬的茎上滑了下去，咚的一声滑到了土里。
款冬姑娘突然有点困了。

[P8] “睡吧，款冬包包要一直睡到春天呐。到了春天，再和伙伴们一起出来吧。在睡着的时候，大地会抱着你的。”
被温暖的土壤气息包围着，款冬姑娘睡着了。

[P9] 款冬姑娘不见了，爸爸在村子里
找了整整一夜。
直到天亮，爸爸才在款冬的叶子
下边，找到了睡着的款冬姑娘。

[P10] 秋天到了，山上的树叶，变成了黄色和金黄色。
刮大风的日子，树叶会从山上吹下来，漫天飞舞。
很快，山上的树就都变得光秃秃的了。
接着，寒冷的冬天来了。

[P12] 漫长的冬天过去了，阳光渐渐地变得明亮起来。
山上除了枯树，都是光秃秃的。却有一个地方，
看上去暖乎乎的。
“妈妈，你看山上的那个地方，上回我就是在那里睡着的啊。”
“可不是嘛，你爬了那么高。”

[P13] 为什么只有那个地方，看上去
总是那么暖和呢？
每当款冬姑娘朝山上看去时，
就会这么想。每次走进院子里，她
都会觉得奇怪。
越是觉得奇怪，款冬姑娘就越
想去看看。蹲下看一看，踮脚瞧一
瞧，款冬姑娘朝山上看了又看。

[P14] 终于有一天，款冬姑娘出发了。
从对面人家的牛棚前面穿过，然后
沿着堂屋后门的山路向上爬。

[P15] 去年夏天，款冬姑娘就是在这个山坡上和款冬们一起玩的。
款冬姑娘拼命地往上爬。

[P16] “啊，款冬包包！
那里，冒出来了好多款冬姑娘的伙伴。
full_text_en:
[P1] The Girl of Kudzu
[Japan] Seizo Tashima, Author & Illustrator
Translated by Peng Yi

This story takes place in Hidaka Village, Nishitama District, Tokyo.
People there call the stem of the kudzu plant "kudzu bao bao." "Bao bao" means "steamed bun." Because the kudzu stem is round and plump, just like a steamed bun.
Seizo Tashima

China Daily Press

[P2] On a sweltering summer night, the Kudou girl couldn't sleep, so she came out to the veranda outside the house.
She looked at the mountain across the way and noticed something strange.
In one spot on the mountain, something was sparkling.
It must be countless stars that had fallen there.

[P3] The Kudou girl set off,
She was going to pick up stars on the mountain.
The path between fields reflected starlight, silver-white. The cow at the opposite house hadn't gone to sleep yet. The Kudou girl walked past the cowshed.

[P4] Following the back door of the main house, there was a path leading up the mountain.
Kuandong girl walked along the path between the oak and beech trees, climbing up the mountain.
After walking for a while, the path became steep.
Kuandong girl thought,
All those stars must have fallen on the mountaintop.

[P5] The Kudzu girl was very disappointed.
Originally, the things that sparkled like stars were countless kudzu leaves,
and the dew on the leaves.
The Kudzu girl gazed intently at the kudzu leaves swaying in the wind...
"Why do you look so sad?"
The kudzu plant closest to her rustled its huge leaves.
"How could I not be sad? I came here to pick up stars, after all."
"Hahaha."
The kudzu leaves rustled.
"We've picked up so many! Look—"
the kudzus said.
Indeed, the dew on the leaves sparkled with starlight.
"Like this, on top of your head, cool and so comfortable."

[P6] The Kudzu girl wanted to balance the night dew on her head, but—roll, roll, it slid down her neck, cool and refreshing.
"Look, like this."
A tall kudzu plant gently swayed its body.
Then, the night dew on the leaves turned into many tiny water droplets, rolling around.
Next, they gathered in the center of the leaf, forming one big droplet.
Then, they slid down like riding a slide, along the grooves of the stem,
finally seeping into the soil at its feet.
"I want to slide too," said the Kudzu girl.
"Huh? You're also called Kudzu?"

[P7] "Yes, everyone calls me Kandou Bao Bao. Look, my face is round and plump. Doesn't it look like a steamed bun?"
"Our child is also called Kandou Bao Bao!"
Unknowingly, Kandou Girl sat on a huge Kandou leaf and began to sway.
She slid down the stem of the Kandou plant, thud, and landed in the soil.
Kandou Girl suddenly felt a bit sleepy.

[P8] "Sleep now, Kandou-bako, you'll sleep all the way to spring. When spring comes, come out with your companions. While you sleep, the earth will hold you." 
Wrapped in the warm scent of the soil, Kandou girl fell asleep.

[P9] The Kuan Dong girl was missing, and her father searched the village all night.
Until dawn, the father finally found the sleeping Kuan Dong girl under the leaves of a Kuan Dong plant.

[P10] Autumn has come, and the leaves on the mountain have turned yellow and golden.
On windy days, leaves blow down from the mountain, dancing through the air.
Soon, the trees on the mountain become bare.
Then, the cold winter arrives.

[P12] The long winter has passed, and the sunlight is gradually becoming brighter.
On the mountain, except for the withered trees, everything is bare. But there is one place that looks warm and cozy.
"Mom, look at that place on the mountain. I was sleeping there last time."
"That's right, you climbed so high."

[P13] Why is it that only that place always looks so warm?
Whenever the Kuan Dong girl looks toward the mountain,
she thinks this. Every time she walks into the yard, she
feels strange.
The more strange it feels, the more the Kuan Dong girl wants
to go and see. She crouches to take a look, tiptoes to peek,
and the Kuan Dong girl looks toward the mountain again and again.

[P14] Finally, one day, the Tussilago girl set off.
She passed in front of the cowshed across the way, then
climbed up the mountain path behind the main house.

[P15] Last summer, the Tussilago girl played on this hillside with the Tussilagos.
The Tussilago girl climbed up with all her might.

[P16] "Ah, Tussilago buds!\nThere, many companions of the Tussilago girl have emerged."
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页是绘本《款冬姑娘》的扉页，介绍了故事发生的地点东京都西多摩郡日出村，并解释了当地称款冬花茎为“款冬包包”的由来，因其外形圆胖像包子。
[P2] 在一个闷热的夏夜，款冬姑娘因睡不着来到屋外走廊，发现对面山上有个地方在闪闪发光，她猜想那是星星落到了山上。
[P3] 款冬姑娘在夏夜出发去山上捡星星，她走过田间小路，经过对面人家的牛棚，牛还未入睡。
[P4] 款冬姑娘沿着屋后的小路向山上走去，小道逐渐变得陡峭，她心想星星一定落在山顶上。
[P5] 款冬姑娘爬上山顶，发现闪闪发光的并非星星，而是款冬叶子上的夜露。她感到失望，但款冬们告诉她，它们捡到了很多‘星星’，并享受着夜露带来的凉爽。
[P6] 款冬姑娘想把夜露顶在头上，但夜露顺着脖梗子滚下。一株高挑的款冬示范如何让夜露在叶面滚动、汇聚并滑入泥土，款冬姑娘表示也想滑，对方惊讶地问她是否也叫款冬。
[P7] 款冬姑娘坐在一片巨大的款冬叶子上摇晃，随后从茎上滑下，落入土中，感到有些困倦。
[P8] 款冬姑娘在泥土中安睡，被温暖的土壤气息包围，画面描绘了她蜷缩在绿色的款冬叶包裹中，背景是星空下的山坡。
[P9] 款冬姑娘在山上睡着后，爸爸在村子里找了整整一夜，直到天亮才在款冬叶子下找到她。
[P10] 秋天到来，山上的树叶变黄并随风飘落，树木变得光秃，寒冷的冬天即将来临。
[P11] 画面中，款冬姑娘站在一片枯黄的田野里，背景是光秃的树木和远处的村庄，天空阴沉，呈现出深秋或初冬的萧瑟景象。
[P12] 冬天过去，阳光变亮，山上光秃秃的，但有一个地方看起来暖和。款冬姑娘和妈妈在山下对话，她指着山上自己曾睡过的地方，妈妈感叹她爬得很高。
[P13] 款冬姑娘每次走进院子，都会好奇地看向山上一处看起来特别暖和的地方，越觉得奇怪就越想去看个究竟。
[P14] 款冬姑娘终于决定出发，沿着村后的小路向山上爬去，画面展现了她从村庄出发、走向山间的场景。
[P15] 画面描绘了款冬姑娘在光秃的山坡上奋力向上攀爬，文字回忆她去年夏天曾在此处与款冬们一起玩耍。
[P16] 款冬姑娘在山坡上发现许多刚冒出的款冬芽，她惊喜地伸出双手，仿佛在迎接这些伙伴。
[P17] 画面描绘了一簇绿色的款冬芽，其中许多芽尖上长出了与款冬姑娘相似的小脸，象征着她与款冬植物的亲密联系和伙伴们的苏醒。
